top_signals.title: Spanish Tungsten Miner Is Said to Plan a London IPO This Year
top_signals.summary: Spanish miner Abenojar Tungsten SA is considering an initial public offering in London this year, driven by Europe’s efforts to secure its own supply of the critical metal, according to people familiar with the matter.

top_signals.title: Nuclear Safety Brings America Into Russia's Uzbek Energy Project
top_signals.summary: Uzbekistan still wants Russia to build its first nuclear plant, but when it comes to safety, Tashkent is turning to the United States. Meeting on the sidelines of the recent general conference session of the International Atomic Energy Agency in Vienna, US and Uzbek officials signed a memorandum of understanding covering monitoring, safe operations and disaster response. top_signals.title: La IA complica a quienes quieren diversificar sus inversiones
top_signals.summary: Los fondos de pensiones y los fondos soberanos, con miles de millones de dólares para invertir, están descubriendo que la diversificación en la que durante años confiaron puede ser, en buena medida, una ilusión.
